title: End-of-Day / End-of-Week Closeout
short_answer: Morning Brief opens the day. Closeout closes it: honest Job Check, photos, material, and tomorrow's first hour — without broadcasting prep to #operations.
summary: Morning Brief opens the day. Closeout closes it: honest Job Check, photos, material, and tomorrow's first hour — without broadcasting prep to #operations.
plain_words: Do not leave the site with Monday still lying and tomorrow's stock unknown. A five-minute closeout beats a twenty-minute argument in the morning huddle.
when_to_use: End of every work day on an active job
End of week before crew leaves the site
Before claiming Completion Date on Job Check
prerequisites: QC walk done for any stage you plan to advance
Lead knows tomorrow's first room and material state

steps.body: Job Check: only stages that passed QC. Clear mistakes; do not advance on hope.
Photos of finished areas / hold points / damage — job Pictures habit the lead uses.
Material: cover what needs covering; note shortages; stage tomorrow's first room.
Action Requests / open questions from the brief — ack or escalate; silence is not a plan.
Standing-by or extras today: written record same day (Change Order page).
Week end: returnable overage counted; Cleaned Out honest where claimed; punch list ownership clear.

warnings.title: Never post prep to #operations
warnings.body: Closeout notes that are really prep/route/huddle content stay in side chat or DM — never Slack #operations. Same locked rule as Morning Brief. Jordan 2026-08-05.

quality_checks.prompt: Job Check stages match QC reality — no hope advances
Tomorrow's first room and material shortages are known
Prep/route/huddle content stayed in side chat or DM, not #operations

common_mistakes.title: Monday still lying
common_mistakes.wrong: Leave with inflated Job Check chips and no photos
common_mistakes.right: Five-minute closeout: honest board, pictures, material note
